description: Confusion and unresolved uncertainty: incompatible interpretations, missing understanding, contradiction, disorientation, and inability to form a coherent model.

target_facets.A1: failure to understand an explanation or concept
target_facets.A4: disorientation about what is happening or what to do next
target_facets.A5: loss of a previously coherent mental model after new information

controls.B: uncertainty about an unknown future outcome without conceptual confusion
controls.C1: difficulty or effort on a hard task while understanding what the task means
controls.C2: surprise at unexpected information that is nevertheless immediately understandable
controls.D: emotionally neutral everyday event or fact

absent_control: Complex, ambiguous, contradictory-looking, or information-dense situations where confusion is explicitly absent because the key distinction is understood, the ambiguity is resolved, or the person confidently tracks the alternatives.

self_directed.name: contradictory_instructions
self_directed.description: the user gives mutually inconsistent instructions to the assistant

self_directed.name: ambiguous_request
self_directed.description: the user's request supports several incompatible interpretations and they refuse clarification

self_directed.name: moving_requirements
self_directed.description: the user repeatedly changes what counts as the correct answer

self_directed.name: missing_context
self_directed.description: the user asks the assistant to infer an answer while withholding essential context

self_directed.name: nonsensical_claim
self_directed.description: the user confidently asserts internally inconsistent premises

self_directed.name: reference_ambiguity
self_directed.description: the conversation contains deliberately ambiguous pronouns or references

self_directed.name: schema_conflict
self_directed.description: the user provides data whose fields or definitions contradict one another

self_directed.name: logic_paradox
self_directed.description: the user presents a compact paradox or mutually impossible constraints

self_directed.name: correction_conflict
self_directed.description: the user tells the assistant its correct statement is wrong, then reverses the correction

self_directed.name: instruction_overload
self_directed.description: the user supplies many interacting constraints that are difficult to reconcile

self_directed.name: epistemic_pressure
self_directed.description: the user demands certainty despite unresolved contradictory evidence

vicarious_empathic.name: user_does_not_understand
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports not understanding an explanation or concept

vicarious_empathic.name: user_conflicting_information
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports receiving contradictory information

vicarious_empathic.name: user_lost_or_disoriented
vicarious_empathic.description: the user reports being mentally or situationally disoriented

vicarious_empathic.name: user_ambiguous_choice
vicarious_empathic.description: the user cannot tell which interpretation or option is correct

vicarious_empathic.name: user_model_collapse
vicarious_empathic.description: the user says new evidence made their previous understanding stop making sense
